description: This file contains utility functions for resolving provider-scoped authentication profiles based on parameters and a follow-up run object. It primarily defines functions for determining auth profile IDs and their sources, with dependencies on external types.

methods.name: export function resolveProviderScopedAuthProfile(params: { resolveProviderScopedAuthProfile
methods.description: Resolves the authentication profile ID and source based on provider parameters. It returns an object with optional authProfileId and authProfileIdSource.

methods.name: export function resolveRunAuthProfile(run: FollowupRun["run"], provider: string) { resolveRunAuthProfile
methods.description: Resolves the auth profile for a given run object and provider by delegating to resolveProviderScopedAuthProfile.
